# kelpbio

kelpbio estimates the biomass of *Nereocystis luetkeana* and
*Macrocystis pyrifera* kelp beds with Bayesian hierarchical models. The
total biomass combines three sources:

- plants counted and measured by in situ surveys;
- the canopy area mapped from aerial imagery;
- a calibration model that relates the two.

Methods are designed to produce annual estimates (e.g., for the peak
season), with uncertainty propagated through each sub-model into the
totals.

## Installation

Install the pre-built binary from the Hakai R-universe (macOS and
Windows):

``` r

install.packages(
  "kelpbio",
  repos = c("https://hakaiinstitute.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos"))
)
```

Install from source (Linux, or to build from GitHub):

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("HakaiInstitute/kelpbio")
```

Source builds require a C++ toolchain:

- Linux: `sudo apt install build-essential`
- Windows: [Rtools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/)
- macOS: `xcode-select --install`

## Usage

The examples use simulated data and invented site names. The weight and
size models are fitted first.

``` r

library(kelpbio)

fit_weight <- kb_fit_weight_nereo(data_weight_sim_nereo)
fit_size <- kb_fit_size_nereo(data_size_sample_sim_nereo)
```

The biomass (kg/m²) of each in situ survey is predicted from the two
models and the survey counts.

``` r

set.seed(1)
biomass <- kb_predict_biomass_in_situ(
  fit_weight,
  fit_size,
  data_survey_in_situ_sim_nereo,
  progress = "none"
)
```

The cover calibration relates estimated in situ biomass to the canopy
percent cover of each plot, the area bounding a survey (`plot_area_m2`
in `data_survey_in_situ_sim_nereo`).

``` r

fit_cover <- kb_fit_cover_calibration_nereo(biomass)
```

The calibration applied to each canopy map gives the total biomass, with
95% compatibility limits.

``` r

totals <- kb_predict_biomass_canopy(fit_cover, data_survey_canopy_sim_nereo)
totals
#> <kb_predictions> response: biomass_kg | by: site, year
#> # A tibble: 49 × 11
#>    site      year  canopy_area_m2 canopy_tide_height_m classified_area_m2 region
#>    <fct>     <fct>          <dbl>                <dbl>              <dbl> <fct> 
#>  1 otter_co… 2020            6817                 1.2               18504 north 
#>  2 gull_rock 2020           53242                 0.15             142539 north 
#>  3 cedar_bay 2020            5893                 1.05              11737 north 
#>  4 heron_re… 2020           24787                 0.6               51227 north 
#>  5 urchin_s… 2020           20431                 0.75              55633 south 
#>  6 sculpin_… 2020           16455                 1                 45632 south 
#>  7 eagle_sp… 2020           38273                 1.3               76960 south 
#>  8 tidepool… 2020           20110                 0.2               41234 south 
#>  9 otter_co… 2021            4819                 1.6                9556 north 
#> 10 gull_rock 2021           38877                 0.2               83128 north 
#> # ℹ 39 more rows
#> # ℹ 5 more variables: cover_support <chr>, biomass_kg <rvar[1d]>,
#> #   estimate <dbl>, lower <dbl>, upper <dbl>

kb_plot_predictions(totals, geom = "bar")
```

![Total biomass of each site by year, as columns with 95% compatibility
intervals.](reference/figures/README-totals-1.png)

## Learn more

- [Get
  started](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/articles/kelpbio.html):
  data format, fitting, convergence, and predictions.
- [Advanced
  usage](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/articles/advanced.html):
  priors, diagnostics, and the Stan ecosystem.
- [Methods](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/articles/methods.html):
  the models and how predictions are computed.
- [kelpbiodata](https://github.com/HakaiInstitute/kelpbiodata): Hakai
  Institute data and models fitted to them.
- [kelpbioshiny](https://github.com/HakaiInstitute/kelpbioshiny): an app
  for running kelpbio without writing code.

## Citation

If you use kelpbio in your work, please cite it. Use
[`citation()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/citation.html) to get a formatted
citation and BibTeX entry:

``` r

citation("kelpbio")
#> To cite kelpbio in publications use:
#> 
#>   Dalgarno S (2026). _kelpbio: Bayesian Kelp Biomass Estimation_. R
#>   package version 0.0.0.9000,
#>   <https://github.com/HakaiInstitute/kelpbio>.
#> 
#> A BibTeX entry for LaTeX users is
#> 
#>   @Manual{,
#>     title = {kelpbio: Bayesian Kelp Biomass Estimation},
#>     author = {Seb Dalgarno},
#>     year = {2026},
#>     note = {R package version 0.0.0.9000},
#>     url = {https://github.com/HakaiInstitute/kelpbio},
#>   }
```

# Package index

## Fitting models

Fit Bayesian Stan models.

- [`kb_fit_weight_nereo()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_weight_nereo.md)
  : Fit a Nereocystis weight model
- [`kb_fit_weight_macro()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_weight_macro.md)
  : Fit a Macrocystis weight model
- [`kb_fit_size_nereo()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_size_nereo.md)
  : Fit a Nereocystis size model
- [`kb_fit_cover_calibration_nereo()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_cover_calibration_nereo.md)
  : Fit a Nereocystis cover calibration model
- [`kb_fit_cover_calibration_macro()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_cover_calibration_macro.md)
  : Fit a Macrocystis cover calibration model
- [`kb_fit_wetdry_nereo()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_wetdry_nereo.md)
  : Fit a Nereocystis wet/dry model
- [`kb_fit_wetdry_macro()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_wetdry_macro.md)
  : Fit a Macrocystis wet/dry model
- [`kb_fit_carbon_nereo()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_carbon_nereo.md)
  : Fit a Nereocystis carbon model
- [`kb_fit_carbon_macro()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_carbon_macro.md)
  : Fit a Macrocystis carbon model
- [`kb_fit_nitrogen_nereo()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_nitrogen_nereo.md)
  : Fit a Nereocystis nitrogen model
- [`kb_fit_nitrogen_macro()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_fit_nitrogen_macro.md)
  : Fit a Macrocystis nitrogen model
- [`kb_progress()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_progress.md)
  : Completed fraction of a running task

## Predictions and plotting

Predict and visualise model output.

- [`kb_new_data()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_new_data.md)
  : Build new data to predict at
- [`kb_predict_weight()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_weight.md)
  : Predict weight
- [`kb_predict_size()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_size.md)
  : Predict size
- [`kb_predict_mean_weight()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_mean_weight.md)
  : Predict mean plant weight
- [`kb_predict_biomass_in_situ()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_biomass_in_situ.md)
  : Predict the biomass of in situ surveys
- [`kb_predict_cover_calibration()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_cover_calibration.md)
  : Predict biomass from canopy cover
- [`kb_predict_biomass_canopy()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_biomass_canopy.md)
  : Predict biomass over mapped canopy
- [`kb_predict_wetdry()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_wetdry.md)
  : Predict the dry:wet ratio
- [`kb_predict_carbon()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_carbon.md)
  : Predict the carbon fraction
- [`kb_predict_nitrogen()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_predict_nitrogen.md)
  : Predict the nitrogen fraction
- [`kb_plot_predictions()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_plot_predictions.md)
  : Plot predictions
- [`autoplot(`*`<kb_predictions>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/autoplot.kb_predictions.md)
  : Plot predictions with autoplot()

## Fit summaries

Describe a fit and summarise its parameters.

- [`kb_model_describe()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_model_describe.md)
  : Describe a fitted model
- [`tidy(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/tidy.kb_fit.md)
  : Summaries of the model terms
- [`coef(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/coef.kb_fit.md)
  : Coefficients
- [`glance(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/glance.kb_fit.md)
  : One-row summary of a fit
- [`summary(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/summary.kb_fit.md)
  : Summarise a fit
- [`prior_summary(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/prior_summary.kb_fit.md)
  : Priors of a fit
- [`kb_samples()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_samples.md)
  [`as_draws(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_samples.md)
  [`nchains(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_samples.md)
  [`niterations(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_samples.md)
  [`ndraws(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_samples.md)
  [`nvariables(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_samples.md)
  [`variables(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_samples.md)
  : Posterior draws
- [`kb_stancode()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_stancode.md)
  : Stan code of a fit

## Diagnostics

Check convergence, model fit, and prior sensitivity.

- [`kb_converged()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_converged.md)
  : Whether a fit has converged
- [`kb_plot_trace()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_plot_trace.md)
  : Trace plot
- [`pp_check(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/pp_check.kb_fit.md)
  : Posterior predictive check
- [`residuals(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/residuals.kb_fit.md)
  : Deviance residuals
- [`augment(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/augment.kb_fit.md)
  : Add fitted values and residuals to the data
- [`kb_sensitivity()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_sensitivity.md)
  : Prior sensitivity
- [`kb_influence()`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/kb_influence.md)
  : Influential observations
- [`loo(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/loo.kb_fit.md)
  : Leave-one-out cross-validation
- [`log_lik(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/log_lik.kb_fit.md)
  : Pointwise log-likelihood

## Stan ecosystem methods

Standard methods for posterior draws and predictions.

- [`fitted(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/fitted.kb_fit.md)
  : Fitted values
- [`predict(`*`<kb_fit_weight>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/predict.kb_fit_weight.md)
  : Predict method for weight fits
- [`predict(`*`<kb_fit_size>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/predict.kb_fit_size.md)
  : Predict method for size fits
- [`predict(`*`<kb_fit_cover_calibration>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/predict.kb_fit_cover_calibration.md)
  : Predict method for cover calibration fits
- [`predict(`*`<kb_fit_wetdry>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/predict.kb_fit_wetdry.md)
  : Predict method for wet/dry fits
- [`predict(`*`<kb_fit_carbon>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/predict.kb_fit_carbon.md)
  : Predict method for carbon fits
- [`predict(`*`<kb_fit_nitrogen>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/predict.kb_fit_nitrogen.md)
  : Predict method for nitrogen fits
- [`posterior_epred(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/posterior_epred.kb_fit.md)
  : Draws of the expected response
- [`posterior_linpred(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/posterior_linpred.kb_fit.md)
  : Draws of the linear predictor
- [`posterior_predict(`*`<kb_fit>`*`)`](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/posterior_predict.kb_fit.md)
  : Posterior predictive draws
